name: Gujarat Winding Systems Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1988, Gujarat Winding Systems Ltd is in the business of manufacturing 
Paper Tubes and Cones.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GWSL trades and produces clean cotton fibre via direct and commission sales. On 29th Nov 2024, it amended its Memorandum of Association to add:
a) Textiles & Garments: Manufacture, process, dye, print, tailor, import/export, and trade fabrics, garments, yarns, sarees, and textiles.
b) Jewellery & Precious Items: Manufacture and trade jewellery, precious/semi-precious stones, metals, watches, and accessories.
c) Gemstones: Cut, polish, process, and trade diamonds, gems, pearls, and related jewellery, including online retail.
d) Agriculture Products: Trade, import/export seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, animal & plant foods, and agro-based chemicals.
e) Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare: Manufacture, process, and trade drugs, formulations, medical devices, and ayurvedic/herbal products.
f) Chemicals: Manufacture, trade, import/export chemicals, intermediates, APIs, and solvents.
g) Mining & Minerals: Explore, mine, process, and trade ores, minerals, metals, coal, and related products.
h) IT & Software: Design, develop, and maintain software, IT solutions, AI, BPO/KPO, e-commerce, and provide consulting and training.
i) Real Estate & Infrastructure: Develop residential/commercial properties, infrastructure projects, and act as builders, contractors, or consultants.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.89 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.48% over last 3 years.
